description: Events on your machines, newest first: machine.ready (with its SSH command), machine.ended (reason says why: evicted when its host took it back or stopped working, otherwise stopped, removal_time, out_of_funds, paused or failed) and machine.notice (its host will take it back or restart it at notice_at, stopped answering, or it failed). Check it when a machine stops answering, and after any alert on a tool result. Free; changes nothing.

since.description: Only events after this ISO 8601 time. Default: 30 days.

name: get_events
title: What happened to my machines
